questions.stem:
The discrete random variable $Y$ has probability distribution
$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline y & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4\\ \hline \mathrm{P}(Y=y) & a & b & 0.3 & c\\ \hline\end{array}$
where $a$, $b$ and $c$ are constants.
The cumulative distribution function $\mathrm{F}(y)$ of $Y$ is given in the following table
$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline y & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4\\ \hline \mathrm{F}(y) & 0.1 & 0.5 & d & 1.0\\ \hline\end{array}$
where $d$ is a constant.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
(a) Find the value of $a$, the value of $b$, the value of $c$ and the value of $d$.
(5)
parts.mark_scheme:
(a) Correct answers with no (or irrelevant) working score full marks
1st B1: for $a=0.1$
2nd B1: for $\mathrm{F}(3)=0.8$ or $d=0.8$
M1: for a method for $b$ or $c$. E.g. sight of $a+b=0.5$ or $a+b+c=0.7$. If their values satisfy one of these equations then score M1 provided their values are genuine probabilities (i.e. $0<p<1$). This M1 may be implied by a correct answer for $b$ or $c$
1st A1: for $b$ or $\mathrm{P}(2)=0.4$
2nd A1: for $c$ or $\mathrm{P}(3)=0.2$
$[\mathrm{F}(3)=\mathrm{F}(2)+\mathrm{P}(Y=3)=(0.5+0.3)]$
$a=0.1$, $d=0.8$, $b=0.4$, $c=0.2$
Official notes (completeness pass):
- $b=\mathrm{F}(2)-a=0.5-0.1$ or $a+b=0.5$ M1
- $c=1-\mathrm{F}(3)$ or $1-(a+b+0.3)$ or $a+b+c=0.7$

parts.label: b
parts.mark_scheme:
(b) M1: for rearranging to $\mathrm{P}(Y\geqslant 2)$ or $1-\mathrm{P}(Y\leqslant 1)$ or selecting cases $Y=2,3$ and $4$
A1ft: for $0.3+\text{their }b+\text{their }c$ or $1-\text{their }a$, provided final answer $<1$ and their values are probabilities.
$\mathrm{P}(3Y+2\geqslant 8) = \mathrm{P}(Y\geqslant 2)$ or $1-\mathrm{P}(Y\leqslant 1)$
$=b+0.3+c$ or $1-a$
$=0.9$
